terms.definition: Closed per-context admissibility map over the frozen treatment universe.
Loss aligned with downstream treatment choice rather than prediction fit alone.
A bounded set of statistically or operationally indistinguishable admissible treatments.
Selection criterion minimizing the worst scenario shortfall against the scenario oracle.
Requirement that uncertainty or non-inferiority failure cannot silently displace the canonical baseline.
Explicit refusal to choose a non-null treatment under ambiguity, support, proof or margin failure.
